mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A supply chain disruption regime defined by declining industrial production (INDPRO) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) compresses corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or joint Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential investment trend (RSAFS) consistently indicates strengthening consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment falling below 480,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 480000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces household income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion regime with strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL < 2.5%, or joint Rank IC remains below 0.02.
